the identification of genetic polymorphisms of drug metabolism and the elucidation of their molecular basis.

dextromethoran O‐demethyiation is a new polymorphism for drug oxidation in man.

the polymorphism in dextromethorphn metabolism is a good surrogate for the polymorphism in debrisoquin metabolism, which is a good surrogate in the metabolism of many drugs.
